Compact, IP65-rated design ideal for roadside and outdoor use.

fastplugPage.title: HORIZOP FastPlug DC Charger
fastplugPage.feat1: High-power DC charging with up to 350kW output
fastplugPage.feat2: Modular design for high uptime and cost-efficiency
fastplugPage.feat5: Can be configured as a Master-Satellite solution
fastplugPage.descriptionContent: High-power DC charger with up to 350kW output, featuring a modular design for reliability and cost-effectiveness. It includes RFID payment, a 14-inch vandal-proof touchscreen, and supports Master-Satellite configurations.
fastplugPage.whatsIncludedContent: FastPlug unit, installation manual, and necessary mounting hardware. Additional components for Master-Satellite setup sold separately.
fastplugPage.salesAndRefundsContent: Please refer to our comprehensive sales and refund policies for details on returns, exchanges, and service agreements. Contact customer support for specific inquiries.
fastplugPage.warrantyInfoContent: The HORIZOP FastPlug comes with a standard warranty covering manufacturing defects and performance issues under normal operating conditions. Extended warranty options are available.

mobileChargerPage.feature1: Portable 7kW AC charger with adjustable current (6-32A)
mobileChargerPage.feature2: Type 2 connector with a durable, weatherproof 5-10m cable
mobileChargerPage.feature3: Smart Functions: Scheduling, remote monitoring, and load balancing
mobileChargerPage.feature4: Advanced Safety Features including RCD protection and emergency stop
mobileChargerPage.feature5: Compact, IP65-rated design for roadside and outdoor use
mobileChargerPage.descriptionContent: The HORIZOP ENERGY 7kW Mobile EV Charger is a compact, portable solution with a weatherproof design and a durable 5-10m cable. It features a Type 2 connector, adjustable current (6A-32A), and supports Mode 2 or 3 AC charging. Smart features include scheduling, remote monitoring via app (Wi-Fi/Bluetooth), and load balancing. Built-in protection covers over-current, voltage, leakage, temperature, and includes an emergency stop to ensure safe use anywhere.

specsContent.safety: Safety: RCD, overvoltage protection, emergency stop

mobileChargerPage.includedContent: Mobile charger with integrated cable and connector, user manual, and a protective carry case.
mobileChargerPage.refundsContent: Please refer to our comprehensive sales and refund policies for details on returns and exchanges. Contact customer support for specific inquiries.
mobileChargerPage.warrantyContent: The HORIZOP Mobile Charger is covered by a standard warranty for manufacturing defects and performance issues. Extended warranty options are available.

pulsarPlusPage.title: HORIZOP SmartPlug
pulsarPlusPage.feature3: User-friendly mobile application for charging monitoring
pulsarPlusPage.descriptionContent: The HORIZOP SmartPlug offers a simple and futuristic design for modern homes. Its easy installation process is backed by a standard 3-year warranty, ensuring peace of mind.
pulsarPlusPage.techSpecsContent: Key features include an output of up to 22 kW for 3-phase AC charging and 7.4 kW for 1-phase AC charging. It has an integrated contactless RFID payment system and a user-friendly mobile application for monitoring.
pulsarPlusPage.whatsIncludedContent: The package includes the HORIZOP SmartPlug charger unit, mounting hardware, and a user manual. Everything needed for a straightforward installation is included.
pulsarPlusPage.salesAndRefundsContent: We offer a comprehensive sales and refund policy. Please consult our terms and conditions for details on returns and exchanges.
pulsarPlusPage.warrantyInfoContent: The HORIZOP SmartPlug comes with a standard 3-year warranty that covers manufacturing defects and malfunctions under normal use.
